Starting my new project HERO (HEterozygous expRession of insulin in NannOchloropsis) at Carnegie Institute of Science, Pasadena Campus (at CalTech).

In this Marie Sklodowska-Curie Global Fellowship, I will try to establish microalgae as an alternate expression vehicle for sustainable and affordable insulin.
(Wish me luck!)
